description: Source code defining the Firefox class extending BrowserType, managing Firefox browser instances, including launch, environment setup, and connection handling within Playwright.

classes.name: Firefox
classes.description: Represents the Firefox browser type, managing launch, connection, environment, and logging behaviors specific to Firefox within Playwright.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a Firefox browser instance, possibly via a bidi Firefox if channel starts with 'moz-'.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with specified options, handling 'moz-' channels specially.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Firefox browser via transport.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include user-friendly messages for common errors.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox, ensuring correct home directory and removing SNAP variables on Linux.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully over the transport.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, resolving when a specific log message appears.
